description.value:
Rocket Boosters attached to the feet of the armor. When used as an action you are considered to have 10 MOVE with no movement penalty until the end of your turn. When used in this way, you can make a single Brawling attack against a target in melee. This attack ignores half armor and knocks the target prone. Can hover in the air at max jump height for one round before landing. Can only be used three times per day.

Where: Body
Fits: Metalgear
